metadata.name: Active Set v6.5.0 - full spine-pack coverage
metadata.description: Adds entityvocab pack: canonical entity resolution rules, per-type identifier schemas, normalization rules, merge/split policy, LLM arbitration prompt template, and enrichment task definitions. Together with nodevocab (entity subtypes) and completenessvocab (dossier scoring), this enables the unified entity resolution pipeline where all entity creation — from signals, enrichment, and watch topics — passes through a single GDU-governed resolver.
metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.purpose: Enable GDU-governed entity resolution: canonical dedup, merge/split with redirects, enrichment queue, and audit trail
metadata.design_basis: Built against the three-layer entity problem: signal-ingest entities (entity_resolver.py), knowledge_nodes entities (knowledge/resolver.py), and watch_topic_entities (processor.py) were disconnected. entityvocab unifies them under one governed resolution path.

metadata.change_log_6_3_0: 2026-07-25 governance re-sync. Brings 7 drifted packs back under the active set. entityvocab 0.3.0->0.6.0 (4 reject patterns already live via filesystem fallback; 7 stub enrichment types dropped; entity_subtypes + alias_seeds now hashed). nodevocab 0.3.0->0.8.1 (ADDITIVE ONLY: +5 categories form/definition/library/issue/mention, +17 subtypes on document/topic/source; collapse_key_rules unchanged so existing base-60 addresses are stable; divisor_policy.json newly declared in manifest). language 0.1.0->0.2.0 (base-60 lexicon). researchpack 1.0.0->1.1.0 (OSINT source routing). gazetteerpack 1.0.0->1.0.1 (one alias: 'united states of america'). numeric + envelopevocab: hash-only, definition 'type' fields realigned to the schema enum (no semantic change). language.frozen_addresses payload moved under 'content' per definition.schema.json. Result: 16/16 packs load canonically.
metadata.change_log_6_4_0: 2026-07-25. Completes the library/pack layer: declares the last two definition files that shipped on disk but were never manifest-listed, so they were excluded from every pack content hash and thus unprotected by the spine. gazetteerpack 1.0.1->1.1.0 (+gazetteerpack.cities, 4,953 GeoNames entries; fixed doubled definition id 'gazetteerpack.gazetteerpack.cities'). language 0.2.0->0.3.0 (+language.exceptions, 4,416 oewn:2023 lemma exceptions; type 'morphology_exceptions'->custom and version 'oewn-2023'->1.0.0 to satisfy definition.schema.json, lexicon tag preserved as metadata.source_lexicon; scripts/build_morphology_pack.py updated to emit schema-valid values). Every definition file on disk is now manifest-declared and hash-covered. 16/16 packs canonical.
metadata.change_log_6_5_0: 2026-07-25. Brings every spine-format pack under the active set: adds displayvocab, precisionvocab, propertyvocab, topicvocab, valuevocab, refdatapack (19 -> 25 packs). These declare pack_id + definitions[] exactly like the packs already governed, and were simply never added, so their content was unpinned. refdatapack's payload moved under 'content' per definition.schema.json; displayvocab and refdatapack had namespaces_owned that did not own their own definition ids. NOT added, deliberately: 'example' (a template — documentation, not governing vocabulary; now schema-valid so copying it yields a pack that passes the ceremony) and the 16 library-format packs (id + manifest[], type lexical|policy — abbreviations, demonyms, glossaries, slang, idioms, function_words, domain_finance, the three *policy packs, wordnet). Those are a different artifact class: they are collapsed INTO the substrate by core/language/library_connect.py rather than governing collapse, and wordnet's data is generated and deliberately not committed.
